text: 9月5日，亚太媒体高端论坛在深圳举办。会上，中国人民银行原副行长朱民发言，强调推动亚太数字化、智能化转型和链接。他呼吁要深化前沿技术合作，加强人工智能（AI）领域协作。同时推动数字经济发展，扩大数字公共服务，促进标准互操作性。（中国日报网）
text_en: At the Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum held in Shenzhen on September 5, former PBOC Deputy Governor Zhu Min emphasized promoting digital, intelligent transformation and connectivity in the Asia-Pacific region. He called for deepening frontier technology cooperation and strengthening collaboration in artificial intelligence (AI), while advancing the digital economy, expanding digital public services, and promoting standards interoperability. (China Daily)
